papers.what_it_is: A theory-plus-simulation paper that defines the data quantum Fisher information metric (DQFIM), whose rank counts the learnable degrees of freedom of a variational ansatz given the training states, bounds that rank by the dimension of the dynamical Lie algebra, and uses it to predict the number of parameters and training states needed for overparameterization and generalization in unitary learning, control, generative, eigensolver and classification tasks.

papers.what_it_is: A predictor-based quantum architecture search method that encodes circuits as graphs, pre-trains a variational graph autoencoder on unlabeled circuits, and trains a small predictor on few labeled circuits, tested in simulation on a 6-qubit TFIM VQE and an 8-qubit entanglement classification task.

(reference 29, called PQAS), on two simulated tasks (a 6-qubit TFIM VQE and an 8-qubit entanglement classification with CE = 0.15 against 0.45). The VQC accuracy differences between all four methods are small (all values lie between about 0.903 and 0.923) and no error bars or significance tests are shown; the VQE gains are larger (Figures 7 to 9).
